reviews.text:
Super friendly receptionists. They remeber you when you bring your pets in and ask how they are doing. Really helpful if you are calling with inquiries too.

Vets are lovely too, so gentle with the pets and very thorough when going over procedures and results of tests
Good luck to you and your animals using this vet. Used to be a great service but not anymore.

Been going here a year now with my pup and always found staff to be friendly and helpful, registered with their care plan so had couple visits for jags and some minor health issues and always received helpful advice and found veterinary staff to be thorough. Like that it’s inside pets at home for treats and a new toy as a reward after a trip to the vets 👌
Absolutely amazing. Thank you so much!

Bishopbriggs Vets4pets branch is a joke. You can’t express your opinion about the service to the reception because it’s classified as abuse, and they’ll strike you off. If you complain further up the management, they’ll just direct you back …
If you love your pet avoid this commercial operation.  All about the £ for them.

If I could give negative stars I would. I brought my cat here due to not eating and weight loss. The vet barely looked at my poor cat, she said it was his teeth and I'd need to get bloods done for 300 and then gave me a quote for further …
